author: ReeceyRages99
body: I would like to start of with a sorry for the incident about the hacking. I will admit there was hacks on my computer and I also will admit my friend installed them although I thought this was funny I had to idea he intended to use them in multiplayer he just told me he used them in single player. Unfortunately I was banned and I wondered if there was anything you could do thanks ..

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

It's your account, and therefore you are responsible for everything that happens. It's not our fault that you were careless. You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax.
